name: node-api-postgres
title: Node API (Hono / Fastify / Express 5 / Nest) + Postgres + Docker
summary: TypeScript HTTP service: Node 22+ (or Bun), one HTTP framework that is not Next.js, Postgres with Drizzle SQL migrations (or Prisma migrate deploy), vitest unit and integration tests against an ephemeral Postgres, Biome or ESLint + Prettier, a Docker image built in CI and deployed to Fly.io / Railway / Render behind a CI gate.
recommended_for: a backend API or service with no browser surface: the API behind a mobile app or a separate frontend, a webhook processor, an internal service, a job runner with an HTTP face
not_for: Next.js apps (use nextjs-vercel-postgres), CLI tools, data pipelines without an HTTP surface, serverless-only deployments

commands.e2e: pnpm test:integration (vitest against the compose Postgres; CI uses a service container)
commands.format: pnpm exec biome format --write . || pnpm exec prettier --write .
commands.build: pnpm build (tsc, or tsup/esbuild to dist/)
commands.migrate_generate: pnpm drizzle-kit generate (Prisma: pnpm prisma migrate dev --create-only)
commands.migrate_check: pnpm drizzle-kit check (Prisma: pnpm prisma migrate status)
commands.migrate_prod: pnpm db:migrate:prod (confirmation-gated runner: scripts/migrate-prod.ts wraps the Drizzle migrator or `prisma migrate deploy`; never `prisma migrate dev` against prod)
commands.deploy: git push origin main (CI builds the image and runs `fly deploy --image` or the platform push; see WORKFLOW.md)

format_cmd: auto (biome or prettier, detected by post-edit-format.sh)
migration_tool: drizzle-kit (SQL files + meta/_journal.json; watermark = journal `when` vs drizzle.__drizzle_migrations.created_at). Prisma alternative: prisma/migrations + _prisma_migrations checksums; `migrate dev` locally, `migrate deploy` inside the runner.
date_helpers: src/lib/date.ts (<formatDate, todayLocalISO>); wire format is ISO 8601 UTC strings, timestamptz at rest
app_verifier_boot: pnpm dev (tsx watch on :3000, needs the compose Postgres), poll GET /health until 200, then drive the changed routes with curl or the framework's in-process request helper (Hono app.request, Fastify app.inject, supertest for Express and Nest)

overlay.rules: rules/*.md replace the core api-boundary/data-layer/services/scripts rules; the core ui.md does not apply to a headless service (delete it)
overlay.qa_pack: none: the integration suite gates and scripts/smoke-test-prod.ts verifies the deployed target
